supplemental-pass: No clipping, overflow, overlapping text, broken characters, or unreadable tables observed after one correction cycle.

passed: The complete desktop and mobile report rendered without page-level horizontal overflow, clipping, overlap, broken characters, or unreadable content. The two wide data tables remain intentionally horizontally scrollable on mobile. Dark-theme toggle changed the theme, button label, and computed page background.

passed: All 10 slides fit without scrolling or horizontal overflow at both tested 16:9 desktop sizes. Mobile layouts remain horizontally contained and scroll vertically where content stacks. Arrow-key navigation updates the active slide, counter, progress, and URL hash. The fullscreen API is available. Printed output contains 10 complete 16:9 pages with no clipped slide content, overlap, broken characters, or unreadable diagrams.

docx.method: Imported into Apple Pages, exported to US Letter PDF, rasterized at 120 DPI, and inspected page by page
docx.result: No clipping, overflow, overlapping text, broken characters, or unreadable tables observed after one correction cycle.
docx.restriction: LibreOffice was unavailable, so the packaged render_docx.py gate could not run.

html.method: Google Chrome headless full-page captures at 1440 px desktop and 390 px mobile widths, inspected in page-height crops; Chrome DevTools Protocol layout and theme checks
html.result: The complete desktop and mobile report rendered without page-level horizontal overflow, clipping, overlap, broken characters, or unreadable content. The two wide data tables remain intentionally horizontally scrollable on mobile. Dark-theme toggle changed the theme, button label, and computed page background.
html.restriction: Local standalone-file rendering only; no hosted-environment behavior was asserted.

presentationHtml.method: Google Chrome headless slide-by-slide captures at 1280x720; layout checks at 1280x720, 1024x576, and 390x844; keyboard/hash interaction checks; 10-page 16:9 PDF print render inspected as a montage
presentationHtml.result: All 10 slides fit without scrolling or horizontal overflow at both tested 16:9 desktop sizes. Mobile layouts remain horizontally contained and scroll vertically where content stacks. Arrow-key navigation updates the active slide, counter, progress, and URL hash. The fullscreen API is available. Printed output contains 10 complete 16:9 pages with no clipped slide content, overlap, broken characters, or unreadable diagrams.
presentationHtml.restriction: Validated as a local standalone file in headless Chrome; hosted delivery and an operating-system fullscreen transition were not asserted.

pptx.restriction: Optional derivative only; presentation.html is the required decision presentation.
